description: This file is a shell script used to run tests on 'git reset' with '--merge' and '--keep' options. It defines test scenarios and expectations for how 'git reset' behaves under different circumstances, including handling of index and working directory changes, as well as merge states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting it to succeed, runs the provided commands, and verifies the expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the provided command and expects it to fail, used to verify error handling.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock/timestamp used in tests to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified path is missing from the filesystem.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that a specified path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_diff
methods.description: Performs diff checks and verifies the output, useful for validating file content and state.
